reviewer: book_search_fix; final read-only verification separate from the root build/browser runner
reviewActions: Read source and baseline diffs, existing real test/upgrade evidence and native static export evidence; independently recompute file/blob/artifact hashes. No browser/build execution or runtime/version changes during this review.

source.dependencyChanges: Only package/app version metadata changed to0.12.1; dependency lists and installed-package lock entries unchanged.

requirements.normalizedBookNames: Shared pure NFKC + German lowercase + Unicode whitespace/period removal; whitespace-only query includes every book in selected scope.
requirements.fullTextSearch: repository.ts and searchBible implementation unchanged; only book-name callers use normalizer.
requirements.ntCatalog: Same normalizer over existing NT_BOOKS only; no AT quiz content added.
requirements.dataNeutrality: New query/scope/open values use component state; new selector has no persistence writes; no LocalAppData/schema changes.
requirements.navigation: Existing book expansion, chapter and book-sword route handlers untouched.

platformSplit.web: Native HTML label/select/options, controlled typed values, visible focus ring and OLIVA theme tokens.
platformSplit.native: Core React Native Pressable/Modal/radiogroup/radio, checked/expanded state; selection/close/back/backdrop handlers; animationType none. No picker dependency.
platformSplit.limitation: Exports/static code inspection prove packaging and platform source selection; native interaction and screen-reader behavior were not exercised on a device or simulator.

existingEvidenceReviewed.fullBrowser: Full114-case run in progress at review time; no final full-suite result claimed.
existingEvidenceReviewed.responsiveAxe: Six book-search browser scenarios passed in targeted run, including320-light/1440-dark Axe, no overflow, keyboard focus and actual chapter/book-sword navigation.

upgrade.comparison: Exact JSON serialization of all raw IndexedDB store values, not physical database-file bytes
upgrade.scope: Local automated Chromium, one persistent profile and origin through actual worker update

nonblockingNotes: Upgrade README reproduction command names a temporary /tmp copy; the intact archived runner is docs/evidence/book-search/upgrade/offline-upgrade-book-search.mjs. Historical preparation state is explicitly distinguished from final passed evidence.
